notes: The full-screen timer now shows how far through the whole task you are, not just this sitting. Under the countdown there is a second, quieter bar reading something like "57m of 3h on this task", and it counts up live while you work rather than jumping only once you stop.
This matters because the timer aims at what is left. On a 3-hour task with 45 minutes already done it counts down from 2h 15m, and nothing on the screen used to tell you those 45 minutes existed.
The small floating timer gets the same figure as a one-line "57m / 3h on task" under its clock.
Running over on one sitting turns the countdown and its bar red, as before. The task bar stays neutral, because going long on one sitting says nothing about the task as a whole.
